properties.name: German field-gun line (deadlock artillery line)
properties.method: drawn through the German gun positions the sources place, local x/y then converted with the frame (Map 7 marks no German batteries): sourced stretches, the upper (western) edges of Farbus Wood and the Bois de la Ville (BOH p. 336, the line of concrete casemates; Nicholson p. 257, field guns firing point-blank in the Bois de la Ville) and of the Bois du Goulot (BOH pp. 335, 337, the line of guns and the gun-pits along the upper edge; hussey-inman-1921 p. 154), the woods as digitized from Map 7 (±100 m). Estimates: south of Farbus Wood, continued due south to y -4700; from the Bois de la Ville to the Bois du Goulot, a straight line; north of the Bois du Goulot, along the eastern foot of the ridge by Petit Vimy and La Chaudière (x 1900, no source places guns there) to the flat east of Givenchy near the Lens-Arras road, where hayes-1920 p. 70 puts German gun pits (x 1800, the place on the flat an estimate), continued north to y 1500. Expected accuracy: ±150 m on the sourced stretches; the estimates, ±500 m or more (command.md, Deadlock)
